## Declarations and implementations

```plato
//==
// # Time
//
// Instants are positions on a time line; durations are differences between them.
// Frame and beat types serve animation, video, and audio-visual work.

// A span of time, stored in seconds. The delta type of Instant.
type Duration
    implements IQuantity
{
    Seconds: Number;
}

// A position on a continuous time line, in seconds relative to an arbitrary
// epoch (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Epoch_(computing)).
// Subtracting two instants yields a Duration.
type Instant
    implements IValue, IComparable, IOriginBased<Duration>
{
    SecondsSinceEpoch: Number;
}

// A half-open span of time: contains Start, excludes End
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Interval_(mathematics)).
type TimeInterval
    implements IValue
{
    Start: Instant;
    End: Instant;
}

// Playback or capture rate, in frames per second
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Frame_rate).
type FrameRate
{
    FramesPerSecond: Number;
}

// A discrete frame position under a given frame rate.
type FrameTime
    implements IValue, IComparable
{
    Frame: Integer;
    Rate: FrameRate;
}

// An SMPTE-style timecode under a given frame rate
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/SMPTE_timecode).
type Timecode
{
    Hours: Integer;
    Minutes: Integer;
    Seconds: Integer;
    Frames: Integer;
    Rate: FrameRate;
}

// Musical tempo, in beats per minute (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tempo).
type Tempo
{
    BeatsPerMinute: Number;
}

// A position measured in musical beats
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Beat_(music)); combine with Tempo to reach
// seconds.
type BeatTime
    implements IValue, IComparable
{
    Beats: Number;
}
```
